units.source_text: 傍晚时分，僧都到小野草庵来了。

en.t: At dusk, the bishop came to the thatched hermitage at Ono.

units.source_text: 侍女们早已把南面的屋子打扫布置，请他入座。

en.t: The ladies in waiting had already cleaned and arranged the south room and invited him to sit down.

units.source_text: 但见许多光头和尚乱哄哄地走来走去，

en.t: But many shaven headed monks could be seen bustling noisily back and forth,

units.source_text: 样子与平日大异，似乎觉得可怕。

en.t: and the sight was so unlike ordinary days that it seemed frightening.

units.source_text: 僧都走到母亲室中，问道：“母亲近来好么？”

en.t: The bishop went into his mother's room and asked, "Mother, how have you been lately?"

units.source_text: 又问：“妹妹到初濑进香去了么？

en.t: He also asked, "Has my sister gone to Hase on pilgrimage?

units.source_text: 找到的那个人还住在这里吧？”

en.t: The person who was found is still living here, is she not?"

units.source_text: 母尼僧答道：“正是，她留在这里。

en.t: His mother, the nun, replied, "Yes, she is staying here.

units.source_text: 她说心情恶劣，想请你给她剃度受戒呢。”

en.t: She says her spirits are troubled and wants to ask you to shave her head and administer the vows."

units.source_text: 僧都便走到浮舟房间门口，问道：“小姐住在这里么？”

en.t: The bishop then went to the doorway of Ukifune's room and asked, "Is the young lady staying here?"

units.source_text: 说着，便在帷屏外面坐下。

en.t: Having said this, he sat down outside the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 浮舟虽然难以为情，只得膝行而前，亲自应对。

en.t: Although Ukifune felt embarrassed, she had no choice but to shuffle forward on her knees and answer him herself.

units.source_text: 僧都对她说道：“我等于无意中相遇，定有前世宿缘，

en.t: The bishop said to her, "Since we met almost by chance, there must surely be a bond from a former life,

units.source_text: 故此次我为小姐禳解，甚是虔诚。

en.t: and so this time I prayed for your deliverance with great sincerity.

units.source_text: 惟我乃法师之身，若无要事，未便致书问候。

en.t: But as I am a priest, unless there is some important matter, it is not proper for me to send letters of inquiry.

units.source_text: 因此自成疏阔。

en.t: For that reason, I have naturally become neglectful in my visits and greetings.

units.source_text: 此间尽是拙陋之出家人，

en.t: Everyone here is a rough and simple renunciant,

units.source_text: 不知小姐居之，能惯适否？”

en.t: so I do not know whether you can grow accustomed to living here."

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“我已决心不欲生存于世，

en.t: Ukifune answered, "I have already resolved that I do not wish to live in this world.

units.source_text: 由于奇特之遭遇，至今犹自苟延残喘，实甚伤心。

en.t: Because of a strange turn of fate, I have somehow kept breathing until now, and it grieves me deeply.

units.source_text: 承蒙多方照拂，我虽不敏，亦知感谢盛情。

en.t: I have received care in many ways, and though I am dull witted, I do understand and thank you for your kindness.

units.source_text: 但我仍是痛感厌世之情，终不能与俗人为伍，

en.t: Yet I still feel a painful weariness of the world and can never keep company with worldly people,

units.source_text: 恳求僧都为我剃度授戒，让我出家为尼。

en.t: so I beg you, Bishop, to shave my head, give me the vows, and let me become a nun.

units.source_text: 此身即使生在俗世，亦不能效寻常女子之为人也。

en.t: Even if this body was born into the secular world, I cannot live as an ordinary woman does.
